subject: [Invite] Physical AI Panel @ AWS Loft 04/15
text:

you a spot / send over an invite.

subject: Scaling Video AI Models since Raise | Encord Intro
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

Saw that the recent news on the raise and that you work exclusively with videos, thought I'd reach out. I work in the Video AI team here at Encord (focused on data curation, annotation & model evaluation, ~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) and we're working with a few of your peers (Synthesia, Captions, Flawless AI, etc.) to develop high quality AI training data pipelines as these teams look to scale. 

Given our platform is unique in that it's the only one to render video natively vs breaking into images/frames - thought it would be worth us being introduced. Keen to get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next ? Pretty open Wednesday and Friday next week.

subject: Fine-tuning VLMs for Atlas
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Have been following the Atlas team for some time now & noticed the recent focus on vision foundation models, so thought I'd reach out to introduce myself.

I lead the Robotics team here at Encord and we've been working with a few of your peers (including Figure AI, 1X & Physical Intelligence) to support the fine-tuning of their VLMs / VLAs - focused on leveraging Agentic workflows to speed up the generation of caption diversity within HITL verification flows. 

Wondering if this was also something you are open to explore on the Atlas team?

If this sounds interesting, would be happy to chat & share what we're seeing work well for our other Humanoid Robotics partners.

Let me know if you're be open to a 30-minute chat later next week? Wednesdays or Thursdays usually work for me,

text:
